In general, the fat-soluble vitamins are readily stored in the body’s adipose tissue; thus, 
we don’t need to consume them every single day.  When we consume more of them than 
we can use, they build up in the adipose tissue, liver, and other tissues and can reach  
toxic levels.

development

A microgram of retinol counts as 1 RAE as does 12 micrograms of dietary beta-carotene.
